paper.title_en: Reconstructing stochastic gravitational-wave signals from flavour deconstruction with LISA
paper.abstract_en: We investigate the reconstruction of a stochastic gravitational-wave background generated by a first-order phase transition in flavour-deconstruction models using the Laser Interferometer Space Antenna (LISA). In these scenarios, the spontaneous breaking of an extended flavour-non-universal gauge symmetry at the TeV scale can both generate the observed hierarchies of Standard Model fermion masses and mixing angles and induce a strong first-order phase transition. We consider representative benchmark points of the model, compute the corresponding thermodynamic transition parameters, and construct the resulting gravitational-wave spectra using a state-of-the-art sound-wave template. We then inject these spectra into simulated LISA data and perform Bayesian inference with SGWBinner, jointly reconstructing the cosmological signal, instrumental noise, and astrophysical foregrounds. We find that the strongest benchmark signal can be successfully reconstructed, whereas weaker signals are substantially degenerate with the unresolved extragalactic compact-binary foreground. We further show that tighter prior information on this foreground, motivated by observations with ground-based detectors, can reduce this degeneracy and improve signal reconstruction. Our results demonstrate that flavour-deconstruction models can produce signals accessible to LISA, while highlighting the importance of astrophysical-foreground modelling for their identification and characterization.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文研究从味道解构模型中重建随机引力波背景，与PTA主题密切相关，方法严谨，结果对LISA探测具有重要意义。
decision.title_zh: 用时LISA重建风味解构的随机引力波信号
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究了使用激光干涉仪空间天线(LISA)重建由风味解构模型中一级相变产生的随机引力波背景。在这些场景中，TeV尺度上扩展的风味非普适规范对称性的自发破缺既可以产生标准模型费米子质量和混合角的观测层级，也可以诱发强一级相变。我们考虑了模型的代表性基准点，计算相应的热力学相变参数，并使用最先进的声波模板构建了由此产生的引力波谱。然后我们将这些谱注入模拟的LISA数据，并使用SGWBinner进行贝叶斯推断，联合重建宇宙学信号、仪器噪声和天体物理前景。我们发现最强的基准信号可以成功重建，而较弱的信号与未分辨的河外致密双星前景严重简并。我们进一步表明，地面探测器观测激发的前景更紧的先验信息可以减少这种简并并改善信号重建。我们的结果表明，风味解构模型可以产生LISA可及的信号，同时强调了天体物理前景建模对其识别和表征的重要性。
